name: Sausage, Broccoli & Cheddar Crustless Egg Bake

fit.band: 463 cal in 400-650 band; 4.2 g carbs under the 35 g cap; no seafood; crustless no-starch oven bake, 8-serving weigh-and-divide scales cleanly to 14; budget meal-prep dinner. Clears every condition.

Nearest catalog neighbor is 'Sausage Hash Brown and Egg Casserole' (sausage-hash-brown-egg-casserole: ground-pork + eggs + cheddar + HASH-BROWNS + milk); that plate is potato/starch-forward while this is crustless, no-starch, heavy-cream-custard, broccoli-forward and low-carb (4.2 g) -- starch base differs, distinct dinner. Also unlike catalog baked-sausage-egg-breakfast-hash (russet potatoes). Distinct from accepted crustless-bacon-gruyere-quiche (bacon/gruyere, no sausage/broccoli).
